claim: The app turns text in a selected screen region into editable text that can be spoken with the device voice.
where: landing headline, desktop app, and README
sandbox: fresh desktop webview; load the bundled screen fixture, select its centre region, assert useful editable rows and excluded header text, then assert the result reaches the speech API

claim: Captured screen images stay on the computer and are not uploaded, and the app sends no telemetry.
where: landing facts, privacy page, and README
sandbox: fresh desktop webview; run bundled local recognition, then assert that the complete flow makes no cross-origin request

claim: The selected speech speed is passed to the device speech API.
where: landing workflow and desktop result control
sandbox: fresh desktop webview; recognise the sample, set speech speed to 1.5, and assert the speech utterance carries rate 1.5

claim: Recognised text can be pinned and removed.
where: landing workflow and demo Pin result button
sandbox: fresh demo at ?demo=1; pin the seeded result, assert its contents, then remove it

claim: The demo opens with a realistic editable result already visible.
where: first-screen demo action and demo page
sandbox: fresh browser context; activate the landing action once and assert the editable inventory result and result actions are visible

claim: Demo sample data is not saved and demo actions do not change real browser data.
where: first action, demo banner, README, and demo notes
sandbox: fresh context with sentinel real keys; edit, pin, and reset the demo, then assert no demo keys and unchanged real values

claim: App captures and pinned results stay in memory and disappear when the capture window reloads or closes.
where: landing privacy boundary, privacy page, and README
sandbox: fresh desktop webview; run bundled recognition, pin the result, assert no stored capture state, reload, and assert the capture and result are gone

claim: The configured capture shortcut is Ctrl+Shift+Space.
sandbox: native unit test compares the shortcut registered by the runtime with Control+Shift+Space

claim: Capture, text recognition, speech, copy, and pin work without an account or supporter license.
where: landing facts, privacy page, terms, and README
sandbox: fresh desktop webview with no auth or license state; run bundled recognition and assert speech, copy, and pin work with no account or license request

claim: The Linux install script verifies the AppImage against its published SHA256 checksum before installing.
sandbox: local fixture release; assert a matching AppImage installs and a tampered file is rejected without creating the command link

claim: The demo works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; load ?demo=1, wait for the service worker, set the context offline, reload, and assert the seeded result

claim: English text-recognition files ship with the app.
sandbox: fetch the same-origin English language data and recognition worker, then assert both contain bundled data

claim: A valid supporter license activates two blueprint page themes.
sandbox: fresh context with a recorded valid license response; select the second theme and assert its palette is applied

claim: A supporter license token and its last check are stored in browser storage and sent only to Sociobot for verification.
sandbox: fresh context with an incoming token and recorded Sociobot response; assert exact storage keys, stripped URL, and the single verification destination

claim: The website has no advertising, user tracking, or third-party scripts.
sandbox: fresh contexts crawl all routes; assert script origins, request destinations, cookies, and storage contain no tracking services or identifiers

claim: The download page asks the GitHub API for the latest release and falls back to the Releases page when none is available.
sandbox: fresh landing contexts record the exact GitHub API request, then return an empty response and assert the calm release-page fallback with no console error

claim: The free core source code is provided under the MIT License.
sandbox: read the shipped LICENSE and assert the MIT grant, copyright notice, and warranty disclaimer

claim: A $19 one-time supporter license is available through Sociobot checkout.
where: landing facts, paid tier, and README
sandbox: live public product catalog must list USD 19.00, then checkout must return HTTP 303 to an HTTPS checkout.dodopayments.com session
